name: Twilight Outpost
summary: At Twilight Outpost, the Twilight's Hammer gathers in southwestern Silithus. Its Wind Stones summon elemental horrors near the Scarab Wall.

sections.title: A Bastion of Whispers
sections.body: In southwestern Silithus, Twilight Outpost is one of the Twilight's Hammer's great strongholds. You find it northwest of the Scarab Wall and west of the Bronzebeard Encampment. Twilight Avengers, Geolords, and Stonecallers fill the camp. Twilight Keeper Exeter and the rare Twilight Lord Everun lead these zealots in service to their apocalyptic masters.

sections.title: The Wind Stones
sections.body: Wind Stones stand scattered through the camp, from Lesser to Greater. The Twilight's Hammer uses enchanted regalia and foul incantations to tear open paths to the elemental planes. Abyssal commanders and elemental lords emerge through those breaches. Disrupting the summons is one way to strike back at the cult's hold in the desert.

faq.q: Where is the Twilight Outpost located?
faq.answer: Twilight Outpost lies in southwestern Silithus, northwest of the Scarab Wall and west of the Bronzebeard Encampment.

The Twilight's Hammer occupies the encampment. Its ranks include Twilight Avengers, Geolords, Stonecallers, and Twilight Masters, led by figures such as Twilight Keeper Exeter and Twilight Lord Everun.

faq.q: What are the Wind Stones found in the camp?
faq.answer: Wind Stones range from Lesser to Greater and let the cult breach the elemental planes. Cultists channel dark energies through them to summon elemental lords and Abyssal commanders into Azeroth.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer gathered near the Scarab Wall?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer gathers near the Scarab Wall for the ancient dark energies beneath Silithus. The cult establishes camps there to summon elementals and harness chaotic forces stirring beyond the sealed gates.

angles.text: As a shaman, you stand against the Twilight's Hammer's corruption and its command of elemental spirits through Wind Stones. That command defies the elements' natural balance.
As a paladin, you face the Twilight's Hammer's nihilistic zealotry as an affront to the Light. Bring holy wrath against its foul summonings in the desert.
